# HIITUN Matrix

> HIITUN Matrix is a desktop workspace for Windows and macOS that manages multiple social media accounts from one place. Log in once per account, write once with built-in AI or your own AI API, and publish to 15 platforms. Drafts, content and account tokens stay on the local device by default.

## Platforms

- 15 platforms: Douyin, Xiaohongshu, Bilibili, Weibo, Zhihu, Toutiao, Baijiahao, WeChat Video, WeChat Official Account, X (Twitter), Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, TikTok, Telegram

## Plans (USD)

- Explore: free, 3 platform accounts, 1 automation profile, 0 starting points
- Standard: $19 per month, 50 platform accounts, 8 automation profiles, 500 points per paid billing cycle
- Pro: $99 one-time payment, permanent activation, 50 platform accounts, 8 automation profiles, 3,000 points once
- Standard and Pro have the same features; only the payment method differs.
- Points: $1 buys 1,000 points in the app. Built-in AI costs 1 point per successful generation or rewrite. Using your own AI API costs no points; you pay the provider directly.
- Plans cover software use only; third-party API fees are separate.

## Download

- Windows x64 and macOS (Apple Silicon and Intel) installers are available on the website and as direct GitHub Releases downloads, no account needed.
- The macOS installers are currently unsigned and not notarized by Apple.
